title: More New Armors
description: 10 new armor and tool sets. Forge 1.20.1 only
body:
More New Armors adds armor and tools from 10 materials: wool 16 colors, slime, nether star, oak, stone, emerald, amethyst, lapis lazuli, copper.

Armor effects work if you wear at least one piece of that set. Tool effects work while holding the tool. If a set's armor is worse than iron, its tools are also worse than iron.

🧶 Wool
Protection: very low, worse than iron
Effect: no fall damage
Tools: none
Color chosen when crafting, cannot be dyed later

🟢 Slime
Protection: poor, worse than iron
Effect: higher jumps and no fall damage
Tools: yes, worse than iron

⭐ Nether Star
Protection: better than Netherite
Effect: Strength V, Resistance V, Regeneration V
Tools: yes, better than Netherite

🌳 Oak Wood
Protection: low, worse than iron
Effect: none
Tools: none

🪨 Stone
Protection: slightly lower than iron
Effect: each worn piece gives slowness
Tools: none

💚 Emerald
Protection: equal to iron
Effect: Hero of the Village
Tools: yes, diamond durability, iron speed

🟣 Amethyst
Protection: slightly better than iron
Effect: none
Tools: yes, slightly better than iron

🔷 Lapis Lazuli
Protection: equal to gold, worse than iron
Effect: none
Tools: yes, worse than iron
Right-click any lapis lazuli tool applies Sharpness 0 enchantment. It gives no bonus and costs no XP

🟠 Copper
Protection: worse than iron
Effect: none
Tools: yes, copper: slightly better than stone, worse than iron

General
Tool sets include: pickaxe, axe, shovel, sword, hoe
Forge 1.20.1, requires Forge API
